name: snd_hdac_regmap_encode_verb
prose: Function-like macro: expands to (((verb) << 8) | 0x80000 | ((unsigned int)(nid) << 20)). It puts the verb shifted left by 8 bits, the constant bit 0x80000 (bit 19) and the NID shifted left by 20 bits into one pseudo register value. The NID is cast to unsigned int first, so the result is unsigned int; the verb is not cast. Neither argument is masked or range checked, so a verb wider than 12 bits or a NID wider than 12 bits would overlap other fields.
note: Macro; no contract (earlier ones failed on bit operations). The old prose assumed nid < 256 and verb < 65536; the macro enforces neither, and the field widths implied by the shifts are not those numbers.

name: snd_hdac_regmap_encode_amp
prose: Function-like macro: expands to snd_hdac_regmap_encode_verb(nid, AC_VERB_GET_AMP_GAIN_MUTE) | ((ch) ? AC_AMP_GET_RIGHT : AC_AMP_GET_LEFT) | ((dir) == HDA_OUTPUT ? AC_AMP_GET_OUTPUT : AC_AMP_GET_INPUT) | (idx). So the pseudo register for the amp gain/mute get verb of NID nid, with the right-channel bit if ch is nonzero (else the left-channel bit), the output bit if dir equals HDA_OUTPUT (else the input bit), and idx ORed in unchanged. idx is not masked or range checked.
note: Macro; the old contract hard-coded numeric constants (0x843, 0x4000, 0x8000) instead of the AC_* names; dropped.

name: snd_hdac_regmap_encode_amp_stereo
prose: Function-like macro: expands to snd_hdac_regmap_encode_verb(nid, AC_VERB_GET_AMP_GAIN_MUTE) | AC_AMP_SET_LEFT | AC_AMP_SET_RIGHT | ((dir) == HDA_OUTPUT ? AC_AMP_GET_OUTPUT : AC_AMP_GET_INPUT) | (idx). It is the same encoding as snd_hdac_regmap_encode_amp but sets both the left and the right amp bits (AC_AMP_SET_LEFT and AC_AMP_SET_RIGHT) instead of selecting one channel. idx is not masked or range checked.
note: Macro; the old contract hard-coded numeric constants; dropped.
